$Comment: The Harvest Tunic, the chest piece of the Harvest Set (ZiggfreedCommon/GearSets/SeasonsOfOrbis/Harvest_Feast_Harvest_Set.json), sold at Martha's shop once a player is Head of the Table with her. A full item body with no Parent, so it inherits no recipe and nobody crafts it: it wears the game's own woolen tunic (its model, texture and icon) and the woolen tunic's armor numbers. Its own stats ride the native Armor block: Health and Stamina like any armor, and ReputationGain_Harvest_Feast_Host (10 is +10%), which raises every gain of Martha's favor while it is worn. Raise or lower an Amount to tune it; the set adds its own bonus on top.
